entry.hypothesis: H5 - scaling SPY exposure to min(1, target vol / last month's realised vol) with the remainder in BIL earns a higher Sharpe than SPY and at least matches 60/40.
entry.rationale: Volatility-managed portfolios (Moreira-Muir 2017) - variance is persistent while the equity premium does not rise with it; unlevered, only the de-risking half remains (Cederburg et al. 2020), so the effect is expected to be weak.
